record.paper_title: Open problems in Gaussian fluid queueing theory
record.original_question: Start the Gaussian fluid queue empty at time 0, so that the transient buffer content at time t is Q^tr(t)=sup_{s∈[0,t]}(X(s)−cs). For a fixed level u, determine the asymptotic behavior as t→∞ of γ(u,t)=P(Q>u)−P(Q^tr(t)>u), where Q denotes the stationary buffer content. In other words, how fast does the transient exceedance probability approach the stationary exceedance probability at a fixed threshold u?

evidence.quote: Assuming that at time 0 the system is empty, the transient buffer content Qtr(t) at time t > 0 obeys Qtr(t) =d sups∈[0,t](X(s) − cs).
Let γ(u,t) := P(Q > u) − P(Qtr(t) > u).
Open Problem 3.1 Find the asymptotics of γ(u,t), as t → ∞, for fixed u.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X = \{X(t) : t \ge 0\}$ be a centered Gaussian process with stationary increments, $X(0)=0$, and almost surely continuous sample paths, with variance function $\sigma^2(t) = \mathrm{Var}\,X(t)$ satisfying the usual regularity assumptions ensuring stability of the associated fluid queue (in particular, the drift condition that guarantees a proper stationary buffer content). Fix a service rate $c>0$ such that $\mathbb{E} X(t) - ct \to -\infty$ as $t\to\infty$ (so that the queue is stable), and define the stationary buffer content
$$Q \;\stackrel{d}{=}\; \sup_{s \ge 0}\bigl(X(s) - cs\bigr).$$
Assume that the system starts empty at time $0$, so the transient buffer content at time $t>0$ satisfies
$$Q^{tr}(t) \;\stackrel{d}{=}\; \sup_{s \in [0,t]}\bigl(X(s) - cs\bigr).$$
For a fixed threshold $u>0$, define
$$\gamma(u,t) \;:=\; \mathbb{P}(Q > u) \;-\; \mathbb{P}(Q^{tr}(t) > u).$$
Determine the exact asymptotic behavior of $\gamma(u,t)$ as $t \to \infty$, with $u$ held fixed; that is, find an explicit function $f(u,t)$ such that $\gamma(u,t) \sim f(u,t)$ as $t \to \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem in the literature on Gaussian fluid queueing theory. Related work on Lévy-driven queues and speed of convergence to (quasi-)stationary distributions exists, but no source found establishes the exact fixed-$u$ asymptotics of $\gamma(u,t)$ for general centered Gaussian input with stationary increments. Status remains unresolved based on available sources.

status_evidence.title: Transient Asymptotics of Lévy-Driven Queues
status_evidence.snippet: Transient asymptotics studied for Lévy-driven (not Gaussian) queues.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous transient asymptotics have been obtained in the Lévy setting, but not for general Gaussian input.

status_evidence.title: Speed of convergence to the quasi-stationary distribution for Lévy input fluid queues
status_evidence.snippet: Studies speed of convergence to quasi-stationarity for Lévy input fluid queues.
status_evidence.claim: Related convergence-rate results exist for Lévy input but not the specific Gaussian fixed-level asymptotics.
